properties.name: --wtv-rem
properties.description: Base sizing unit for proportional scaling (default: 10px)

properties.name: --wtv-border-width
properties.description: Hairline stroke width of the context menu, checkbox and debug panel (→ --base-border-width, 1px)

properties.name: --wtv-danger-text-color
properties.description: Danger as text (context menu danger item); reads --base-danger-text-color

properties.name: --wtv-selected-bg
properties.description: Selected-row background tint (the click / Ctrl / Shift-click set); reads --base-selected-bg (fallback --base-primary-bg-subtle, then accent 10% / 20% dark)

properties.name: --wtv-selected-text
properties.description: Text color of a selected row; reads --base-selected-text-color (fallback currentColor)

properties.name: --wtv-selected-ring
properties.description: Outline shorthand for a selected row, drawn as an inset outline; reads --base-selected-outline (fallback none)

properties.name: --wtv-focused-bg
properties.description: Background of the focused (cursor) row when not selected; reads --base-focused-bg (fallback transparent)

properties.name: --wtv-focused-text
properties.description: Text color of the focused (cursor) row; reads --base-focused-text-color (fallback currentColor)

properties.name: --wtv-focused-ring
properties.description: Outline shorthand for the default focus ring, drawn as an inset outline; reads --base-focused-outline (fallback 1px solid accent). Set none to suppress the ring while keeping the --focused hook

properties.name: --wtv-focused-outline-offset
properties.description: Outline offset for the focus ring / selected ring (default calc(-1 * var(--base-outline-width, 1px)) = inset)

properties.name: --wtv-selected-fill-bg
properties.description: Background for the opt-in .wtv__node-content--selected-fill flavor (Explorer-style strong fill); unused by the default selected state

properties.name: --wtv-selected-fill-color
properties.description: Text color for the opt-in .wtv__node-content--selected-fill flavor (default inherit)

properties.name: --wtv-selected-preset-ring-color
properties.description: Hairline ring color of the opt-in --selected-border / --selected-glow presets (accent 45%)

properties.name: --wtv-node-transition
properties.description: Node content (row) transition. Default none = instant hover; set e.g. 'background var(--wtv-transition-speed), box-shadow var(--wtv-transition-speed) ease' to animate

properties.name: --wtv-node-icon-color
properties.description: Per-node icon color (default currentColor; overridden by a per-node iconColor / iconColorMember)

properties.name: --wtv-node-icon-margin-right
properties.description: Gap between the per-node icon and the label

properties.name: --wtv-node-icon-width
properties.description: Reserved icon-column width when shouldAlignNodeIcons is on

properties.name: --wtv-column-width
properties.description: Unified column width for toggle, icon, and indent step (24px)

properties.name: --wtv-icon-expand
properties.description: Disclosure glyph mask (collapsed / the only glyph in rotate mode); chained to --base-icon-chevron. Re-pointed per icon-set.

properties.name: --wtv-icon-collapse
properties.description: Disclosure glyph mask shown when expanded (swap mode only); chained to --base-icon-collapse for the plus-minus set.

properties.name: --wtv-icon-leaf
properties.description: Optional leaf marker glyph mask (opt-in via leafIconClass=wtv__toggle-icon--leaf).

properties.name: --wtv-icon-rotate-collapsed
properties.description: Collapsed-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (0deg for a right-pointing chevron, -90deg for a down-caret).

properties.name: --wtv-icon-rotate-expanded
properties.description: Expanded-state rotation for the disclosure glyph (90deg for chevron).

properties.name: --wtv-icon-check
properties.description: Checkmark glyph (mask) for a checked checkbox; chains to --base-icon-check.

properties.name: --wtv-icon-indeterminate
properties.description: Dash glyph (mask) for a tri-state/partial checkbox; chains to --base-icon-indeterminate.

properties.name: --wtv-icon-check-size
properties.description: mask-size of the check/dash glyph inside the box; chains to --base-icon-check-size (default 68%).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-gap
properties.description: Space between the checkbox and the node pill

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-scale
properties.description: Box/border/radius scale via calc (shared --base-checkbox-scale contract, no transform).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-border-width
properties.description: Checkbox box border thickness (→ --wtv-border-width; multiplied by --wtv-checkbox-scale).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-border-color
properties.description: Unchecked checkbox box border color; chains to --base-checkbox-border-color.

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-border-radius
properties.description: Checkbox box corner radius (flat 0.3×rem, scaled by --wtv-checkbox-scale).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-checked-bg
properties.description: Checked / indeterminate checkbox box background (defaults to the accent color).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-checked-border-color
properties.description: Checked / indeterminate checkbox box border color.

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-checked-bg-hover
properties.description: Checked / indeterminate checkbox background on hover (accent hover step).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-checkmark-color
properties.description: Check / dash glyph color (tints the mask).

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-width
properties.description: Focus-ring thickness for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-focus-ring-color
properties.description: Focus-ring color for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

properties.name: --wtv-checkbox-focus-ring
properties.description: Composed focus-ring box-shadow for a keyboard-focused checkbox.

properties.name: --wtv-drag-denied-flash-bg
properties.description: Optional: pulse color of the "can't move / drop here" row (default danger 18%)

properties.name: --wtv-dragged-scale
properties.description: Scale of the dimmed dragged node(s), left-anchored (0.95; set 1 to disable)

properties.name: --wtv-cut-opacity
properties.description: Opacity of cut nodes pending paste (0.4)

properties.name: --wtv-tooltip-width
properties.description: Node tooltip width (auto = shrink-to-content; set a length for a fixed box + max-width:none)

properties.name: --wtv-tooltip-min-width
properties.description: Node tooltip minimum width (0 = none; a floor that still grows up to max-width)

properties.name: --wtv-tooltip-max-width
properties.description: Node tooltip max width (wrap point; set none when using a fixed width)

properties.name: --wtv-context-menu-icon-width
properties.description: Icon column width in context menu

properties.name: --wtv-context-menu-icon-font-size
properties.description: Icon font size in context menu

properties.name: --wtv-expand-spinner-size
properties.description: Per-node loading spinner size while an async beforeExpandCallback is pending (0.9em)

properties.name: --wtv-tree-min-height
properties.description: Min height for empty and loading states (60px)

properties.name: --wtv-empty-zone-radius
properties.description: Empty tree drop zone border radius (8px)

properties.name: --wtv-empty-zone-hover-bg
properties.description: Empty drop zone background when engaged (hover / drag-over)

properties.name: --wtv-empty-zone-hover-border-color
properties.description: Empty drop zone border color when engaged

properties.name: --wtv-empty-zone-hover-shadow
properties.description: Empty drop zone glow when engaged (box-shadow)

properties.name: --wtv-empty-zone-hover-scale
properties.description: Empty drop zone scale when engaged (default 1; >1 can cause horizontal overflow)
